item.title: They're lying about casualties
item.description: Front page: YouTube is suppressing me, after I've spoken up about Israel. Go figure. Kind of depressing, because I was starting to pick up steam, but hey, yet again, trying to say what's right limits me. Oh well. We persist. Some neat news. A veteran friend of mine has signed me up for a competition that might result in me going to flight school. I am nervous as hell, but can't pass up on an opportunity like that. The continued news and knowledge of just how much we're being lied to is crushing me. I can't say I'm doing well. It's times like these I miss drinking. Source https://youtube.com/shorts/B4dRk8TCu0k An article https://thehill.com/newsletters/defense-national-security/5993089-pentagon-mum-as-us-casualties-in-iran-war-rise/
